en: Changed in a future release, on or after November 30, 2026: plugin marketplaces in managed `extraKnownMarketplaces` will auto-update by default. To opt one out, set `"autoUpdate": false` on its entry
zh: 变更将在 2026 年 11 月 30 日或之后的未来版本中生效：托管 `extraKnownMarketplaces` 中的 plugin marketplace 将默认自动更新。要退出某个 marketplace 的自动更新，请在其条目上设置 `"autoUpdate": false`
